title: Stocks: analysing a company
summary: Reading the income statement, balance sheet and cash flow; margins and return on capital; valuation with P/E, earnings yield and dividends; and judging business quality, competition and risks, using fictional companies.
practicalResult: In the Fundamental Analysis Lab, compare the four fictional companies on margins, net debt, cash flow and P/E, and write a short note on one company covering its business model, advantages, risks and what its price assumes.
